title: Rigidity of maps between configuration spaces
summary: Let $n\geq5$ and $m\geq3$. Let $Φ\colon\mathrm{B}_n\to\mathrm{B}_m$ be a homomorphism of braid groups. We prove that if the image of $Φ$ is irreducible and not cyclic, then $m=n$ and $Φ$ agrees with an automorphism modulo the center $Z(\mathrm{B}_m)$. This resolves in the affirmative a conjecture of Chen, Kordek, and Margalit. It also provides a partial resolution to a problem on the K3 problem list.
